__comment: Finance (Financial Health Score board) gRPC Documentation — apps/finance_service/src/finnace.controller.ts
meta_note: All methods are exposed on the FinanceService gRPC server. Auth is enforced at the module level via RpcAuthGuard; the authenticated user is injected via @RpcUser(). Proto definitions live in packages/types/proto/finance/finance.proto.

conventions.auth: JWT injected via @RpcUser() decorator; guard applied at module level (RpcAuthGuard).

rpc_errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Missing or invalid JWT in gRPC metadata

score_model.description: Single 0–100 weekly Financial Health Score, the sum of four weighted components. Component caps mirror the Decimal(4,1) columns on the FinanceScoreBoard model and the weights in packages/types/src/constants/finance.constant.ts.

components.budgetScore: Budget adherence — fraction of active budgets within their effective limit this month (max 35)
components.savingScore: Savings rate — (monthlyIncome - monthlyExpense) / monthlyIncome, clamped to [0,1] (max 25)
components.goalScore: Goal pacing — fraction of ACTIVE goals on pace vs. their target timeline (max 25)
components.splitScore: Split settlement — fraction of splits fully SETTLED (max 15)

score_model.empty_category_rule: When a category has nothing to assess (no budgets, no income, no active goals, no splits) it scores full marks — absence of a problem is treated as healthy.
score_model.shared_formula: Pure scoring math lives in @fintrack/utils/finance_score and is shared with the scheduler's weekly snapshot job so the live board and persisted history never drift.

getFinanceBoard.description: Computes the live current-week Financial Health board for the authenticated user — each weighted component plus the composite score — in one read transaction. Savings and budget adherence are assessed over the current calendar month; goal pacing and split settlement reflect current state. The reported window is the current ISO week (Mon→Sun).

output.start_date: string — ISO date (Monday of the current ISO week)
output.end_date: string — ISO date (Sunday of the current ISO week)

errors.INTERNAL: Unexpected error while computing the board

getFinanceBoardHistory.description: Returns the user's persisted weekly score history — the most recent 12 weeks, in chronological (oldest→newest) order for charting. Snapshots are written every Monday by the scheduler's FinanceScoreProcessor (FINANCE_SCORE_SNAPSHOT_JOB).

output.history: FinanceBoard[] — up to 12 weekly snapshots, oldest-first; each carries its own persisted id and Mon→Sun window
